releaseNotes:
Official Update v1.3.8 (Pontiac field fixes):
- Local silent receipt printing at each register, with Check (bill) vs Sale logic so the cash drawer only opens on real sales.
- Instant cash drawer service (local, 0.05 sec) started automatically.
- Cloudflare tunnel supervisor: starts automatically, auto-restarts and downloads cloudflared when missing.
- DHCP auto-discovery for station installers (no fixed server IP needed).
- Station configuration for secondary registers (server and station number).
- Cake orders: automatic Balance Due and deposit validation.
- Numeric keyboard layout fix.
- Optional multi-printer kitchen routing, configured per business in Settings.
- Photo Hub live refresh.
